blocks.text: Berapa harga purata servis aircond murah KL?

blocks.html: Harga kami sangat berpatutan bermula dari RM 60 ke RM 80 untuk cucian biasa (general service) bagi unit 1.0HP. Walau bagaimanapun, harga untuk chemical wash dan top-up gas bergantung pada saiz HP dan tahap kekurangan gas aircond anda.

blocks.text: Kenapa aircond saya keluar air menitik (leaking) di dalam bilik?

blocks.html: Masalah air menitik selalunya disebabkan oleh saluran paip pembuangan air (drain pipe) atau takung air (drain pan) yang telah tersumbat dengan lendir habuk atau "jelly". Pakej Servis Chemical Wash kami akan membuang sumbatan ini serta-merta dan menyelesaikan masalah bocor.

blocks.text: Berapa kerap saya perlu panggil orang servis aircond?

blocks.html: Untuk penggunaan rumah biasa (dipasang pada waktu malam sahaja), kami mengesyorkan servis cuci biasa setiap 3 ke 4 bulan, dan chemical wash setahun sekali. Sebaliknya, jika aircond dipasang siang dan malam atau di lokasi berhabuk, servis perlu dilakukan lebih kerap.

blocks.text: Adakah anda menyediakan jaminan (warranty) selepas servis?

If you live in a condo or a double-storey house, a dripping plaster ceiling is usually caused by the bathroom directly above it. The original waterproof membrane beneath the bathroom tiles has degraded, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.
Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through.

sections.title: 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hacking Required)

Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection.

We drill small holes into the concrete slab where the leak is occurring. Using a high-pressure pump, we inject liquid polyurethane resin into the cracks. When the resin meets the trapped water inside the concrete, it reacts instantly—expanding up to 30 times its volume to form a tough, waterproof rubber seal that permanently blocks the water path.
For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays.

We use Torch-On Bituminous Membrane. This involves rolling out sheets of modified asphalt (bitumen) reinforced with polyester. We use a blowtorch to melt the underside of the sheet, fusing it directly to the concrete. This creates an impenetrable, flexible layer that can withstand structural movements and severe weather.

sections.title: 2. Inverter vs. Non-Inverter: Is it Worth It?

blocks.html: When browsing for a new unit, you will see a significant price difference between Inverter and Non-Inverter models. Is the extra RM 300 - RM 500 worth it?

A non-inverter motor runs at 100% speed until the room is cold, then shuts off completely. When the room warms up, it blasts at 100% again. This "Stop-Start" motion consumes a lot of electricity—similar to driving a car in heavy traffic.

An inverter motor varies its speed. Once the room is cold, it slows down to a low maintenance speed to keep the temperature steady. It never fully stops. This is like highway driving—smooth and efficient.

Choose Inverter for bedrooms and living rooms where you use the AC for more than 4 hours a day. The electricity savings (up to 40%) will pay for the price difference within 1 year.

Choose Non-Inverter for guest rooms or server rooms where usage is rare or the door is frequently opened.

/pu-injection-waterproofing-kl-how-to-fi.sourceH1: PU Injection Waterproofing KL: How to Fix Wall Cracks Permanently

blocks.html: PU stands for Polyurethane. PU Injection (also known as PU Grouting) is an advanced waterproofing technique used specifically to stop active water leaks through cracks in concrete structures.

Liquid polyurethane resin is injected directly into the concrete crack using a high-pressure pump. The magic happens when this resin comes into contact with the water trapped inside the wall. It reacts instantly, expanding up to 30 times its original volume to form a dense, tough, waterproof foam. This foam perfectly fills every microscopic void, permanently sealing the water's path.

Because it specifically targets the inside of the concrete slab, it is the most effective PU injection waterproofing KL residents can use for basement leaks, leaking RC flat roofs, and dripping plaster ceilings originating from the bathroom above.

sections.title: 2. Why Do Concrete Walls & Ceilings Crack?

blocks.html: Concrete is strong, but it is not invincible. If you are looking for a wall crack repair service KL, your property is likely suffering from one of the following:

items.text: Thermal Expansion: Kuala Lumpur experiences scorching heat followed by sudden, freezing thunderstorms. This rapid temperature change causes concrete to expand and contract daily, eventually leading to hairline fractures.

items.text: Building Settlement: As a new house settles into the ground over its first few years, the structural shift naturally causes minor cracks in the walls and foundation.

items.text: Degraded Waterproofing Membranes: The original waterproofing layer laid by the developer under your bathroom tiles usually degrades after 5 to 10 years, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.
items.html: Degraded Waterproofing Membranes: The original waterproofing layer laid by the developer under your bathroom tiles usually degrades after 5 to 10 years, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.

sections.title: 3. How the PU Grouting Process Works (No Hacking)

blocks.html: The greatest advantage of PU injection is that it requires zero hacking. You don't have to destroy your beautiful, expensive bathroom tiles to fix the leak underneath them. Here is our step-by-step process:

Step 1: Leak Identification
We inspect the yellow stains or dripping areas on your ceiling or wall to identify the exact path of the water.

Step 2: Drilling Injection Holes
We drill small, highly precise holes (about 45 degrees) intersecting the crack in the concrete slab.

Step 3: Inserting Packers
We insert mechanical injection packers (metal valves) into the drilled holes. These will act as the gateway for the resin.

Step 4: High-Pressure Injection
Using a specialized high-pressure machine, we pump the liquid polyurethane resin through the packers. You will literally see the expanding foam push the trapped water out of the crack before sealing it completely.

Step 5: Curing & Finishing
Once the foam cures (hardens), we remove the packers, clean off the excess foam, and patch the drill holes with waterproof cement.

blocks.text: Berapa harga Servis Cuci Rumah KL?

blocks.html: Harga kami bergantung pada saiz rumah (sqft) dan jenis cucian. For instance, untuk cucian 'Move-in Deep Clean' bagi apartment 1000sqft, harga bermula sekitar RM 300 - RM 400.

blocks.text: Adakah anda bawa peralatan mencuci sendiri?

blocks.html: Ya. Untuk pakej Servis Cuci Rumah KL (Deep Cleaning dan Post-Renovation), kami membawa semua peralatan. Ini termasuk mesin vacuum heavy-duty, tangga, kain, dan bahan pencuci kimia.

blocks.text: Berapa lama masa diambil untuk mencuci rumah?

blocks.html: Ia bergantung pada kekotoran rumah. Typically, sesi Deep Cleaning mengambil masa antara 4 hingga 6 jam dengan pasukan 2-3 orang pekerja terlatih.
Atas sebab keselamatan, kami hanya mencuci tingkap bahagian dalam. However, kami boleh mencuci bahagian luar yang boleh dicapai dengan selamat dari balkoni sahaja.
